# GCI Completes Acquisition of Quintillion


November 09, 2026 1:57pm EST[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_5cc6a9789066fb91a6350ee58fc33d90/gciliberty/news/2026-11-09_GCI_Completes_Acquisition_of_94.pdf)


*Combined fiber network strengthens reliability through unified, Alaska-based operations*


ANCHORAGE, Alaska--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- GCI Holdings, LLC (“GCI”), a wholly owned subsidiary of Liberty Capital Corporation (Nasdaq: GLIBA, GLIBK), today announced the completion of its acquisition of Q Gateway Intermediate Holdings, LLC (“Quintillion”), an Alaska fiber infrastructure provider.


This press release features multimedia. View the full release here:[https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261108228290/en/](https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261108228290/en/)


The completion of GCI's acquisition of Quintillion strengthens the integrated fiber infrastructure serving communities across Alaska, including Kotzebue (pictured).


The transaction brings Quintillion’s more than 1,800 miles of existing subsea and terrestrial fiber and approximately 1,500 miles of planned fiber expansion together with GCI’s statewide communications network under a unified operational framework supporting better coordinate planning, monitoring, maintenance and restoration.


“Bringing these networks together will increase routing diversity and support greater reliability across Alaska,” said Billy Wailand, Senior Vice President of Corporate Development at GCI. “Our Alaska-based teams are passionate about GCI’s vision—for all Alaskans to be connected. Working together with local stakeholders, we look forward to integrating Quintillion’s network into our own and using the combined network to deliver fast, reliable service that supports a thriving and healthy rural Alaska.”


**What Happens Next**


GCI will begin integrating Quintillion into its statewide network. Existing customer relationships, contractual obligations and service arrangements will continue without interruption as the integration moves forward.


GCI will also continue advancing Quintillion’s ongoing fiber expansion and grant-funded projects, working with customers, communities and project partners throughout the transition.


**About GCI**


Headquartered in Alaska, GCI provides data, mobile, voice and managed services to consumer, business, government, and carrier customers throughout Alaska, serving more than 200 communities. The company has invested more than $5 billion in its Alaska network and facilities over the past 45+ years. Through a combination of ambitious network initiatives, GCI continues to expand and strengthen its statewide network infrastructure to deliver the best possible connectivity to its customers and close the digital divide in Alaska. Learn more about GCI at[www.gci.com](http://www.gci.com/) . GCI is a wholly owned subsidiary of Liberty Capital Corporation (Nasdaq: GLIBA, GLIBK).

**About Liberty Capital Corporation**


Liberty Capital Corporation (Nasdaq: GLIBA, GLIBK) consists of its wholly owned subsidiary GCI. GCI is Alaska’s largest communications provider, providing data, voice and managed services to consumer and business customers throughout Alaska, serving more than 200 communities. GCI has invested more than $5 billion in its Alaska network and facilities over the past 45+ years. Through a combination of ambitious network initiatives, GCI continues to expand and strengthen its statewide network infrastructure to deliver the best possible connectivity to its customers and close the digital divide in Alaska.
